apollo-desktop.panel: Known limitations Fixed to the J2000 frame: no precession and no star proper motion, so it does not change with the clock. Stars are tinted from the B-V colour index and sized by magnitude; they are not photometrically exact. Sources Yale Bright Star Catalogue, 5th Revised Ed. (Preliminary Version), Hoffleit and Warren, ADC/NSSDC 1991 (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/V/50/). Fetched to this mach
